text: Aquabellos are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Keves Castle Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony 11 Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.
Anti-Grav Chassis are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Amoney Flower Lures are items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region.
Antol Leg Chitins are items in . They can be dropped by Master Antols in Erythia Sea.
Antol Queen Shells are items in . They can be dropped by Antol Queen enemies.
Archbard Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 46-47 on Daedal Isle and level 99-100 in the Demihuman Gutter in Erythia Sea.

Archknight Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 47 on Daedal Isle, level 75 on Lavi Sandbar, and level 96-97 in the Demihuman Gutter in Erythia Sea.
The Arcaphor Gogol is a Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Gogol family, and is fought at level 47 at Cape Arcaphor in Erythia Sea during Doing It My Way.
Amity Skeeters are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Skeeter family, and can be found at level 21-23 in Millick Meadows in the Aetia Region.
Anita is an NPC in who can be found in Colony 9. She is a lifelong friend of Kurt. __TOC__

The Archaic Tower (Japanese: , Taiko no Shikakutō) is a Location in . It is located in the High Maktha Wildwood in the Pentelas Region. It is a building from the Land of Morytha. The Tower Camp is located inside.

Analyzer Scopes are Accessories in and . They can be bought from the Nopon Coin X-change for 15 Gold Nopon Coins. In , they can be bought from the Colony 9 Supply Office for 91300 G after completing Abandoned Supplies.

Ardun Psychology is a Key Item in . It is the second volume of a two-book set, coming after Armu Psychology, and details how one should raise of Arduns. Both volumes can be purchased for 5000 G from Wellwell's Emporium during The Future I Want to Spin.
The Ancient Taos Fossil is a Key Item in . It is a fossil of a Taos that is found on Daedal Isle during Doing It My Way.
Andaris Crustips are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 51-52 in Svinne Cavity in Yzana Plains.
Api is a Nopon NPC and in . They are the lieutenant of Colony 15
The Archsage's Page, Red is a NPC in . She runs the Prize X-change Red shop located in the Land of Challenge.
Archsage's Aide, Red is a NPC in . He runs the Class Mastery Shop Red shop located in the Land of Challenge.
Annihilation Events are a type of event that occurs in and .

Aquaball (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Covetous Gerondon while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Aquatic Missile is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Frolicking Parker while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

The Argent Ropl is a DLC Quest Exclusive Boss in . It is a member of the Ropl family, and is fought at level 51 in the Urayan Tunnels during For the Sake of Keepsakes. It drops the Argencium after it is defeated.
Argencium is a DLC Key Item in . It can be obtained by defeating the Argent Ropl during the Quest For the Sake of Keepsakes. Masha uses it to make the Contract Bracelets for Jake and Tessa.
The Archsage's Gauntlet is a type of Challenge Battle in . It becomes available after completing More Challenge Battles!.
Archsage's Aide, Blue is a NPC in . He runs the Class Mastery Shop Blue shop located in the Land of Challenge.
The Archsage's Page, Blue is a NPC in . She runs the Prize X-change Blue shop located in the Land of Challenge.

The Archsage's Flower Fan is a DLC Accessory in . It is received from the Nopon Archsage after clearing all Challenge Battles with S Rank. In New Game +, the Nopon Archsage will reward the Humongous Nopon Doll instead if the player has already acquired the Archsage's Flower Fan in a prior playthrough.
Amina Ignas are Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 22 in the Exile Fortress Ruins on the Aurora Shelf during Riku's Workshop.

Anima Ignas are four Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 23 at the Exile Fortress Ruins on the Aurora Shelf where they are summoned by the Wickt Igna during Riku's Workshop.

* Archsage's Aide, Blue * Archsage's Aide, Red * Archsage's Flower Fan * Archsage's Gauntlet * Archsage's Orderly * Archsage's Page, Blue * Archsage's Page, Red * Archsage's Private Chef * Nopon Archsage
The Ares may refer to: * Ares 70 * Ares 90 * Ares Prime * Ares (boss) * Prog Ares * Prog Ares (holofigure)

The Ares Prime, or simply known as the Ares, is a Samaarian Skell in . The Ares is the original Skell, which served as a model for all other Skells, both manmade and Ganglion. The Prog Ares, Ares 70, and Ares 90 models are all directly based on its design. The Ares Prime appearance was first shown in the Xenoblade X: The Secret File, before its appearance in the . Al piloted it in the game's prologue to protect the White Whale from the Ghosts. It initially disappeared along with Al shortly after the ship crashed in Mira. Al and the Ares Prime reappear to fight the invading Ghosts in Chapter 13. This Skell is initially locked to Al during the events of Chapter 13, except during the second pha

Arctoras's Axle is a landmark in . It is located in Boötis Reef in Volitaris. One of the Shackle of Samaar is found here. However, in order to activate it, the three Trinity Galdrs must be defeated in order to obtain the three Shield Release Keys that lift the shield protecting it.

Apex Predator is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the balcony of the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia between Ga Jiarg and Cross. It is the only Heart-to-Heart that is not found in New Los Angeles.

Apocalypsis, the Sacrificant (Japanese: , Seishi no Apokaripushisu) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Ghost family. It can be found at level 99 in Sylvalum during and after Chapter 13 (Act 2), after rescuing Omomo. It floats in front of the de-mat zone in the sky east of FN Site 420.
|-|Real Mode= |-|Imaginary Mode= Angel Arrow (Japanese: , Enjeruarō) is MOMO's Level III Blade Special in . When MOMO is in Imaginary Mode, this Special turns into Angel Arrow (Dark).

Ash Foxes (Japanese: , Asshu Fokkusu) are collectables in . They can be found in Makna Forest. According to their description, they are long-haired grey foxes that are often kept as pets. Four are required for Collection Quest 3 in Frontier Village.

Arnaut (Japanese: , Arunoruto) is a Homs in . He can be found in Colony 9. From 18:00, he appears and leaves his lab close to the Weapon Development Lab. From 19:00 - 03:00 he can be found at the Fortress Entrance.

Arm Bunnits (Japanese: , Āmu Banitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 11 on Kneecap Hill near Tephra Cave. They resemble overgrown rabbits, and they each have a long tail with three finger-like appendages at the end. They can drop the Bunnit Sapling needed for Bionis' Leg's Material Quest 3.

Art Core Coils (Japanese: , Āto Koa Koiru) are collectables in . They can be found in Galahad Fortress. According to their description, they are strange blue metal artifact and it is hard to believe that they are machine-made. Two coils are needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction. In the , they can be purchased from the Nopon Archsage in Time Attack for 18,900 Noponstones.

Atael (Japanese: , Ateru) is a High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. He is the son of Vol'aren, and Cian's brother. He can be found running around near Vol'aren and Cian southeast of the Fountain of Hope, past the escalator in Alcamoth. After the events at the Mechonis Core, he can be found in Frontier Village north of the Reservoir, under the roots near the ship from 6:00 to 15:00. He can be difficult to see among the foliage.
Army Pikes (Japanese: , Āmīpaiku) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be bought from several shops or traded for.
Asura Helms (Japanese: , Ashura Herumu) are heavy head armour in . They are part of the Asura Set and can be dropped by various enemies.
Asura Arms are heavy arms armour in . They are part of the Asura Set and can be dropped by various high-level enemies.
Asura Cuisses are heavy legs armour in . They are part of the Asura Set and can be dropped by various high-level enemies.
Asura Greaves are heavy feet armour in . They are part of the Asura Set and can be dropped by various high-level enemies.

Armus (Japanese: , Aruma) are enemies in the . They look somewhat similar to a rhino, and live in grasslands. All Armu use the same model. Ardun: There are very few differences between an Ardun and an Armu; according to the Traditional Chinese localization of as well as the English localization of , Arduns and Armus are, respectively, the male and female versions of the same species.

Arielle (Japanese: , Arietta) is a pureblooded High Entia in Xenoblade Chronicles. She resides near the Fountain of Eternity in Alcamoth. She is the mother to Lesunia and her dream is to one day see her getting married. Sadly, she states that Lesunia is not interested in such things, despite having a pretty face. She also says that Lesunia is very intense, so a soppy man will be no good for her. Arielle then jokingly asks if the male characters of the party are interested in a strong-willed girl; however, party members do not comment. After the events of Mechonis Core, Vidian reveals that she was transformed into a Telethia by Zanza and protected her when she fled Alcamoth alongside Lesunia
Attack Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Attack Goggles (Japanese: , Atakku Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of the basic attack set for Fiora, along with the Attack Frame, Attack Arms, and Attack Boosters. Attack Goggles can only be obtained by purchasing them from the shop in the Hidden Machina Village.

Astarte Drones are Mechonis Drones in Xenoblade Chronicles. They give Fiora the Cannon Drones II talent art. They can be bought at the Machina Refuge Shop or Colony 6 Shop 7, and are dropped by M68/MISERs.
Attack II Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack II Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack II Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Attack II Goggles (Japanese: , Atakku II Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of the Attack II set for Fiora, along with the Attack II Frame, Attack II Arms, and Attack II Boosters. They also come with an Arts Heal V gem.

Attack III Goggles (Japanese: , Atakku III Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of the Attack III set for Fiora, along with the Attack III Frame, Attack III Arms, and Attack III Boosters. Attack III Goggles can only be obtained by purchasing them from various shops.
Attack IV Goggles (Japanese: , Atakku IV Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Asura Plates are heavy torso armour in . They are part of the Asura Set.
Atomic Drivers (Japanese: , Atomikkubankā) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn, and can be obtained from various high-level enemies.

Arkose Pikes (Japanese: , Arugosupaiku, Argos Pike) are weapons in . They are gunlances wielded by Reyn. They can be acquired by trading with Françoise who can be found in Colony 9. They can also be obtained as a quest reward.
Asuras (Japanese: , Shurazakura, Asura Blossom) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban. They can only be obtained by purchasing them at the Frontier Village Weapon Shop for 23,400 G.
Argos Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of the Argos Set and can be found in the Hode Refuge in Eryth Sea after obtaining the High Entia Emblem.
Argos Gear (Japanese: , Arugosu Gia) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is part of the Argos Set.

Aries (Japanese: , Ariesu) are a family of enemies in the . They are relatively rare heavyset deer-like enemies found exclusively in cold regions. Ories: There are very few differences between an Aries and an Ories. It is assumed that Ories are male and Aries are female, and that this is the only reason for their name differences.

Aura Seal is a debuff in and . It can only be inflicted by Monado Purge. Aura Seal prevents enemies from using auras and removes the effects of any Aura the enemy has activated. It also prevents enemies from inflicting any Spike Damage. Although Melia's Mind Blast does not inflict this Debuff, it also ends active Auras.

|-|Unique = |-|Unslotted = Attack III Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles. There are exceptionally two variants of this armour item, a Unique one that can be bought in the second shops of Junks or Hidden Machina Village, and a unslotted one that can be dropped by the Magnificent Digalus. The unslotted variation has been removed in the Definitive Edition.
Arts Stealth (Japanese: , Waza Heito Teika, Art Hate Lowering) is a Gem in that reduces volatile aggro drawn from enemies by activating Battle Arts. __TOC__
Auto-Atk Stealth (Japanese: , Heito Teika, Hate Lowering) is a Gem in that reduces Aggro from Auto-Attacks. __TOC__

Arts Heal (Japanese: , Ātsu Hīru) is a Gem in that heals Hit Points when using Battle Arts to attack enemies. This gem's effect only applies when an attack with an Art connects. This means that Aura-based arts do not generate healing, while area-of-effect or multi-hit arts can heal multiple times. __TOC__
Auto-Heal Up (Japanese: , Shizen Kaifuku Appu, Natural Heal Up) is a Gem in that increases the rate of HP recovery outside of combat. __TOC__

Aura Heal (Japanese: , Ōra Hīru) is a Gem in Xenoblade Chronicles that restores Hit Points every two seconds while an Aura is active. This gem is only activated when a character wearing it uses a Battle Art which produces an aura. These Arts can be identified by their orange icon. __TOC__
Arts Seal Resist (Japanese: , Ātsu Fūin Teikō) is a Gem in that increases the chance of resisting Arts Seal. __TOC__
Aura Bullet (Japanese: , Ōra Baretto) is one of Sharla's support arts in . It increases the duration of any aura by ten seconds. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Aurorora Bullet.
Attack IV Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack IV Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack III Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack V Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack IV Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Attack III Arms are Mechonis arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles.

Assault Flamiis (Japanese: , Kyūshū no Furamī) are quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flamii family, and can be found in the Tranquil Grotto on Bionis' Leg only during the Earnest's Mischief quest. They will drop a Fertile Flamii Egg, which is needed for Material Quest 1.

The Arrogant Tirkin (Japanese: , Zōchō no Tākin) is a one-of-a-kind quest exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Tirkin family, and can be found at the far northeast corner of the upper level of Bionis' Leg, directly north of Kasharpa Falls. Defeating it is required for the quest that it spawns during, Earnest's Solitude. It will drop a Tirkin Crest, which is needed for Material Quest 2.

Atmos Fliers (Japanese: , Atomosu Furaia) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 25 outside Colony 6, near the Hope Farm before the events at Mechonis Core, or at Pod Depot after these events.

Asha Telethia (Japanese: , Āsha Tereshia) are enemies in . They are Phoenix-type members of the Telethia family, and can be found at level 68 outside Colony 6 on the Freight Road and the Splintered Path after the events at Mechonis Core.

Asara Telethia (Japanese: , Asara Tereshia) are enemies in . They are Licorne-type members of the Telethia family, and they can be found in several locations after the events of Mechonis Core. They can be found at level 68 outside the Main Entrance of Colony 6, at level 89 in Eryth Sea, and at level 90 on floors GF and 1F of Alcamoth.

Ashy Orlugas (Japanese: , Hai yogore Oruga) are quest exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at levels 38 - 41 near the Nopon Arch during the quest Giant Attack!. Three of them must be defeated to complete the Giant Attack quest. They drop the Orluga Grass Skirts needed for Material Quest 2.

The Argos Set is a Medium Unique (also one per playthrough) set of items that look like the Alcamoth-themed clothes, like the Eryth Set—blue, Mithril Set—green, Stellar Set—blue, Rafaga Set—purple, and the Agrius Set—purple. The Argos Set has the second highest most base defenses of all Medium Armour. The Glory Set has the highest overall base defenses for Medium Armour. Of the set, Argos Leggings have a weapon based gem: Aggro Up V 20% pre-slotted making it a viable candidate for tank use for the preservation of a weapon slot. The Argos armour set is composed of five items: * Argos Gear * Argos Armour * Argos Gauntlets * Argos Leggings * Argos Boots
Astas (Japanese: , Asutasu) are floating robotic enemies in . They are only found in the High Entia Tomb. They are somewhat similar to Andos in function, but look and behave differently.

Astas Remote Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Astas in the High Entia Tomb and traded for in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are impressive remote devices that have a range of 750 metres. Three of them are needed for A Necessary Upgrade.

The Attachment Part is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Finding it is the objective of Starlight Gazer, to improve a telescope given to Elior by Miriall. It can be found in the Second Treasury of the High Entia Tomb.

The Asura Set is a Heavy armour set in Xenoblade Chronicles. It resembles the Orion Set. It can only be obtained in late game. It is a unique set, which means that it has predetermined gems. It follows the style of the Machina in its design. Note that being a unique set, it is less effective in some ways than the Rex Set, which can have up to one empty slot, despite the physical defense advantage. The Asura Set is composed of five items: * Asura Helm * Asura Plate * Asura Arms * Asura Cuisses * Asura Greaves Illustrious Golteus drops all the items in the Asura set, so it can be good to farm.

Armour Shards are Key Items in Xenoblade Chronicles. One is dropped by Telethia Galvin during A Merciful End. It is a fragment of Galvin's armour and becomes a keepsake for Rozeal. Four more shards are dropped by Telethia Galdo, Telethia Lecrough, Telethia Donnis and Telethia Kaelin during A Release From Duty. Rozeal also keeps them safe as memories of the Imperial Guards.

Arielle's Ring is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a ring that belonged to the High Entia Arielle, and is dropped by Telethia Arielle during I Will Never Forget You or The Only Thing I Can Do. The party gives it to Vidian when the quest has been completed.
Assassin Masks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They cannot be traded for, and are only held by Scout Entia for one battle.

Atop the Crown Tree (Japanese: , Ōkina Ōkanju no Ue de) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in the branches of the Crown Tree in Satorl Marsh, between Sharla and Riki at pink affinity. It becomes available after the Leone Telethia is defeated.
At the Pollen Works (Japanese: , Konshū no Kafun Kōjō) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Pollen Works in Frontier Village, between Shulk and Riki at green affinity.
Astral Heal is a Support Battle Art in . It costs 1000 TP to cast. It restores HP to an ally, and restores all appendage HP if it is used on a Skell.

Assault Rifles are ranged weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. In the beginning of the game, this is the initial ranged weapon Cross can use as a Drifter. Assault Rifles are retained when changing to Striker, and can be further mastered through Samurai Gunner and Duelist Classes. Assault Rifles are also the ranged weapons used by Gwin, Irina, Alexa, and H.B..

The following pages show all of the armour that can be worn by each character in the original , with identical sets and colour variants grouped together. The skin ID is given at the top of each column, and identifies the armour series and the colour variant within that series. Clicking on the "Show" link under an image will show the names of armour having that appearance. Note that armour names and appearances differ in , and are listed on the Appearance page.

Arms Manufacturers, or AMs, are corporations in and where armaments are developed for characters and Skells. These include corporations such as Sakuraba Industries, Grenada Galactic Group, and Meredith & Co. The party can cooperate with them by promoting their products (by equipping them and using them in battle) or by providing Miranium. This cooperation allows the AMs to expand and upgrade their product lines. This corporation group is also known as Arms Company (Japanese: , Āmuzu Kanpanī) in the Japanese version. Arms Manufacturers are supported by the Outfitters Division within BLADE.
Atomic Hit is one of H.B.'s two Signature Arts in . It can be learned by Cross by completing The King of Fear.
Assault Breaker is a Melee Battle Art in . It inflicts Stun if used from behind.

Armory Alley (Japanese: , Shoppu-gai, Shop Street) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles, along the north side of BLADE Tower. It is the place of the armory shops, the Shop Terminal and L's Shop, and the armory crafting at the AM Terminal.

Aria, the Zauberflöte (Japanese: , Mateki no Aria) is a Tyrant in . It is a Saltat and can be found at level 13 near Rust Lake in Noctilum. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Aria, the Zauberflöte.
Ataraxia Oc-servs (Japanese: , Atarakushia Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 48-50 at Talon Rock Summit in Primordia.
Assault Hammer is a Melee Battle Art in . It is one of Cross's two initial Arts as a Drifter, and is learned by Irina at class rank 12 and Alexa at class rank 8.
Aura Ready is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a character activates an aura art.

The Arrow Cinicula (Japanese: , Arou Vasaruto) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Cinicula and is fought at level 18 in Qing Long Glade in Noctilum during Close Comrades. It is accompanied by the second wave of Arrow Germivores.

Assault Pugiliths (Japanese: , Asaruto Berudero) are Story Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion vehicles, and can be found at level 28 in NLA's Commercial District during Chapter 8 when the Ganglion attack.

Assault Qmoevas (Japanese: , Asaruto Kumūba) are two Story Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 29 grey Qmoevas, and may appear during the second wave of attacks at the NLA Primary Defense Line in Primordia during Chapter 8. One Assault Qmoeva is equipped with a Ganglion Railgun while the other is equipped with a Spike Cannon. Both are equipped with a Boggle Bomb and Multi Laser.
Ashizels (Japanese: , Ashizeru) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, specifically in the southeast part of the region.

Assassin Springtails (Japanese: , Asashintobimushi) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular in the North Janpath Plain. Two of them are needed during The Miracle Maker.
Astral Protection is an aura Art used by the Psycho Launchers in . It is a default art for the Galactic Knight Class. It boosts all attribute resistances and restores HP when using arts.
Astral Purge is one of many Support Arts in . It is learned by the Galactic Knights. It removes all debuffs on the user or an ally.
Auravises (Japanese: , Akuira) are large horned birds in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Arwae (Japanese: , Arwe) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Hangar in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Atreides, the Distinguished (Japanese: , Kōketsu no Atoreide) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sabula family. It can be found at level 74 at South Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum, leaping out of the ground in the day and resting with its mouth out of the ground at night. When its health is reduced to about half, it summons Gesserith, the Wileworm.

The Arrow Germivores (Japanese: , Arou Burōsu) are ten Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family. They are fought at level 14-16 in Qing Long Glade in Noctilum during Close Comrades, in two waves of five each. During the second wave, they are accompanied by the Arrow Cinicula.

Arnacian Orewoods (Japanese: , Arunashia Kōju) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. It is found in the southwest part of Primordia in the early morning, night, or when it is rainy. Two are needed for the Basic Mission Elusive Orewood. fr:Cristal d'arnacian

Auroran Bones (Japanese: , Aurora no Hone) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found inside caves in Primordia, such as the Beasts' Lair and Rock Cavern, as well as around Arendt Bridge. Two are required for the Basic Mission Hazmat Hunt.

The Autiga Powder (Japanese: , Autiga no Kona) is a rare collectible in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found in Cauldros, in particular at FN Site 503 and around the White Phosphor Lake. Four bags of Autiga Powder are needed for the Normal Mission The Big Bang.
Aurorites are common Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Five of them are needed for Noctilum Trailblazing 1, and fifty are needed for The Platinum Membership.
Arms Testers Wanted is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Outfitters to test a weapon and the primary destination is Primordia.

Attack is a weapon stat in Xenoblade Chronicles which determines the amount of Damage dealt by Auto-Attacks and Battle Arts, as well as the amount of HP restored by healing arts. It is displayed as a minimum value and a maximum value separated by a hyphen, for example "180–310". When a character auto-attacks or uses an attack or healing art, the game chooses a random value between the minimum and maximum attack, and uses it to calculate the amount of damage or healing. However, due to a bug in the game's damage calculation, the random value is effectively limited to minimum+99, so a weapon with an Attack of 180–310 will in practice be only 180–279. This bug is not present in Xenoblade Chroni
The Armed Engineer Galdr (Japanese: , Sentō Kōhei-gata Garudora) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 41 northeast of Far Isle of Tzu'o in Cauldros.

The Armed Recon Galdr (Japanese: , Teisatsu Sentō-gata Garudora) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Galdr machine. It can be found at level 65 in the Cauldros Waters, directly west of the Far Isle of Tzu'o.

The Armored Cruiser Seidr (Japanese: , Jūjunkō-gata Basugia) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Seidr machine. It can be found at level 61 at O'rrh Sim Watchtowers in Cauldros during the day, at about the northeast corner of the marked sector on foot.
Auto Melee Boost is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Samurai Gunner at rank 3.

Auravis Croaking Bags are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the backs of black Auravises in Oblivia. Two are needed for The Stick. They are used to craft Resist Topple and Resist.TOPPLE augments.

Auravis Courtship Feathers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Auravises' tail. Ten are required to complete Off the Record (biological). They are also used to craft rank I - V Weather Master and Weather.DAMAGE-RES augments.
Auravis Horns are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the horns of Auravises. They are used to craft rank I - V Front Attack Plus and PositionDmg.FRONT augments.
Arsenican (Japanese: , Arasenikan) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a Zaruboggan and can be found in the Central Industrial District. They are also the parent of Orleron.

Arms and the Man (Japanese: , Ieruvu no Sagashimono, What Yelv Seeks) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received near the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District and the primary destination is Oblivia. The Mimeosome Left Arm is received upon completion of this mission. Route A of this mission leads to a conversation with Eleonora which changes the affinity link between her and Yelv.

Auld Belgazus (Japanese: , Arudo Berugazasu) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone and can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day. He is Duna Valdileo's, Liana Valdileo's and Nemard Wolfen's grandfather.
Atheron (Japanese: , Aseron) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are a Zaruboggan and can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

The Armored Sphinx (Japanese: , Āmādo Ryuosu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sphinx family. It is fought at level 35 in the Beasts' Lair in Primordia during Cavern Crushers.
Aura Assault is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Blast Fencer at rank 7.

Assault Barrager Zigs (Japanese: , Asarutobaretto Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 37 on rock structures northwest and south of FN Site 416 in Sylvalum.

Assault Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Asarutokyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 45-47 on a floating sphere by Badr Stronghold, or at level 43 on Lesser Anvil and Badr Stonebridge in Sylvalum.

Assault Launcher Zigs (Japanese: , Asarutoranchā Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 60 at Xanadu Overlook in Sylvalum. One must be defeated during Arms Testers Wanted.

Auto Gunner Zigs (Japanese: , Ōtokyanon Jigu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Zig machines, and can be found at level 42 on Adder Byroad near Ternion Fork, and at level 47 on the path leading to Wildcat Fortress in Cauldros.

Attack on Biahno Hills (Japanese: , Biāno Kyūryō Kyōshū Sakusen) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Lara Nara, between the Transport Pilot's vehicle and the green helicopter that are parked in front of BLADE Tower, in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. This mission is available after having spoken to Suriella near the BLADE Barracks. Although it is not required the Basic Mission Ambush can be used to locate this mission.

The Atropos Puge (Japanese: , Atoroposu Berude) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Puge machine, Ganglion's human size robot, and can be found at level 28 at Bandits' Refuge in Cauldros. Defeating it is required during Rites of Ruin.

The Array Insidia (Japanese: , Parako Arei), known as the Array Caecus in the , is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Contrary to its name, it is a member of the Caecus family. It is fought at level 30 at Coil Tree Cape in Noctilum during Lone Survivors.

Attribute Resistance Probes are types of Data Probes in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They boost the value of all resistances for all allies in that region by 16 points at max, which is two probes placed on combat support S spaces. It is expressed as a buff (rank I-V), regardless of being in a battle. The most visible one is found in a patrol chopper wreckage on top of Mount M'gando in Cauldros, this wreckage requires level 5 Mechanical Field-Skill. In Sylvalum, a different one is located inside of a second patrol chopper wreckage southeast of FN Site 419, close to a group of Adseculas, somewhat below the Delusians South Summit.
Arts: Gain TP is a ground Weapon art mod Augment in and . It boosts TP by 10 to 200 when using an Art.

Auravis Laughing Bags are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the backs of light-colored Auravises in Primordia and Noctilum. They are components in all Resist Launch and Resist.LAUNCH augments.
Armored Suid is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts an armored purple suid variant. It can be obtained from Bogdan, the Dense in Primordia.
Auravis A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a brown auravis variant. It can be obtained from Bohdan, the Mistral in Primordia during the day.
Auravis B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black auravis variant. It can be obtained from Gotthard, the Intimidating in Oblivia.
Assassins is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts the Milsaadi assassins involved during White Lifehold. It is obtained as a reward for completing this Normal Mission.

At Waterway Tangle is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.13, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting three Thunderbolt Emblems. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

As If a Cloud is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and is intended to make it easier to level up characters by earning EXP, Class EXP, and Battle Points. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Aural Cloaking is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that reduces the radius of detection for sound-detecting enemies. The Skell equivalent is Cloak.SOUND.
Aura Surge is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the chance of triggering the Aura Ready Soul Voice.
Aura Rapid Cooldown is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that reduces cooldown of Arts when an Aura is active.
Aura: Refuel is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that restores Skell Fuel when using an Aura.
Arts: Recover HP is a ground weapon art mod augment in and . It allows a character to recover from 10 to 200 hit points when using an art.
Art Draw Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chance of triggering the Opening Art Soul Voice by 5% to 25%.
Artful Execution Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chances of triggering the Artful Execution Soul Voice by 10% to 50%.
AttributeDmg.PHYS is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell physical damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Physical Attack Plus.
AttributeDmg.BEAM is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell beam damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Beam Attack Plus.
AttributeDmg.ETHER is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell ether damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Ether Attack Plus.
AttributeDmg.THERM is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell thermal damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Thermal Attack Plus.
AttributeDmg.ELEC is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases electric damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Electric Attack Plus.
AttributeDmg.GRAV is a Skell frame attack augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell gravity damage by 10% to 50%. The ground equivalent is Gravity Attack Plus.

Assault Galdr (Japanese: , Asaruto Garudora) are Mission Exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Galdrs and can be found at level 37 in Primordia's Bedrock Hold during route A of Blitzkrieg. They are part of an onslaught of enemies that must be defended against for three minutes.

Assault Puges (Japanese: , Asaruto Berude) are Mission Exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Puges and can be found at level 27 on Primordia's East Gate Plain during route B of Blitzkrieg. They are part of an onslaught of enemies that must be defended against for three minutes. They do not drop any items.
|-|R320 Model= Assaults are sidearms for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Rail-Gun/M-Laser/E-Bubble types Qmoevas or male Milsaadi.
Audacious Glaives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 396,000 Credits.
Audacious Glaives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 594,000 Credits.
Audacious Lances are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 514,800 Credits.
Audacious Edges are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 356,400 Credits.
Audacious Lightblades are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 554,400 Credits.
Audacious Lightblades II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 554,400 Credits.
Audacious Edges II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges II Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 356,400 Credits.
Arts.GP is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It boosts GP when using a Skell Art. It is the Skell equivalent of Arts: Gain TP.

Auto-Attacks are a battle mechanic in and . During a battle, a character will automatically perform an auto-attack with their weapon if they are within range. Sharla and Kino can perform an auto-attack at range with their respective weapons. All other characters will need to be in melee range to perform an auto-attack. It is not possible for a player-controlled character to stop auto-attacking if the character is within range and is involved in combat. For a character controlled by the player to stop auto-attacking, one will need to move out of range, use an Art, or be in the process of helping a toppled, dazed, or sleeping party member. It should be noted that auto-attacks will not occur if
Armor Crusher (Japanese: , Āmābureikā, Lit. "Armor Breaker") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using an Ether Cannon.
Armored Brennan (Japanese: , Kōgai no Dairu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Driver and a member of the Ropl family, and can be found at level 86 at the Chansagh Wastes in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Aspars (Japanese: , Angu) are a family of enemies in the , first appearing in . They are large, serpentine creatures, with bird-like features, and come in white, brown, and purple varieties.

Atrocious Hermes (Japanese: , Zannin-ō Gerumesu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Igna family and a Driver, and can be found at level 58 at the Bastion of Varrac, West of Toxbloom Spring on the Central Plain of Temperantia. It must be defeated in order to unlock Finch's level 5 Whoopsie Crazy, and Zenobia's level 5 "Greatest Warrior" on their affinity charts. He can be fought at level 106 during Humanoid Alliance, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Artifice Ophion (Japanese: , Sāpento Debaisu), or Ophion for short, is an enormous serpentine Artifice guarding the World Tree, appearing in and . As an Artifice, it was wielded by Mythra during the Aegis War.

The Armory (Japanese: , Heiki Seibishitsu) is a landmark in . It is a large room on the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province, between the Sickbay and the Hangar. The Level 2 Access Key can be found here. There are no enemies here.

Artificial Blade Adjustment (Japanese: , Jinkō Bureido Chōseishitsu) is a Location in . It is located in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The Unique Monster Antecedent Xiaxia can be found here upon reaching the First Low Orbit Station for the first time.

The Armory, 2nd Floor (Japanese: , Heiki Seibishitsu 2-kai) is a location in . It is located inside the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province, directly above the Armory and accessible from the Hangar Passage. The Heart-to-Heart between Rex and Tora, "Ardainian Technology", is located here.
Armu & Bean Stews are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Bassani Butchers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Army Field Manuals are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Elgeschel Hobby Store in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one Newt's favorite Pouch items.
Army-Issue Violins are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Adelno Music in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of T-elos's favorite Pouch items.
Armu T-Bone Steaks are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Volty Butchers in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Vandham.
Armu-Skin Gladiators are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya.
Aromalocaris Sautés are Seafood Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Tatraty Fish in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Dagas.
Astrology Made Simple are Literature Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Biblio Paulio in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Kasandra.

Attas is an NPC in . Attas is a Gormotti shopkeeper who can be found in the Gormott Province's Torigoth. Attas runs a shop called Tilly Bakery specialized in Staple Foods, which notably sells the Lucky Dawn Bread needed for Our Daily Bread. Attas offers no quests or merc missions.

Artifice Colossi (Japanese: , Taitan Debaisu) are enemies in . They are the only Artifice enemies that are not Unique Monsters or Bosses. They can be found at level 67-69 in the Colossus Hangar of the First Low Orbit Station. They can also be summoned by Artifice Aion during the final battle in the Aion Hangar. The Colossi summoned by Aion have lower stats than naturally spawned ones.

Armored Centipedes are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Gormott Province, specifically at the Collection Point east by northeast of Umon's Shipyard. In the , Armored Centipedes can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Armu Milk Earl Grey are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cafe Lutino after it relocates to Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago. To unlock, the Wagon Guard Merc Mission must be completed, which in turn requires Development Level 4 in Leftheria. One of them is required to make the Trial Snipe Flan for Follow Your Passion. Ten are also required to get Sheba's Financial Settlement skill to level 5.
Atonement is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Theospiti Temple Ruins in the Kingdom of Tantal. It must be viewed to unlock Herald's Lv 2 Key Affinity. __FORCETOC__

Ashe is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier, and can be found in the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province, where he trains recruits. He gives the quest Whereabouts Unknown. If Floren is in the party and has Lv 3 Beguiling Charms, he will give an unrefined Ether Def Up II.

Arno Kapibas (Japanese: , Ānoru Kapība) are enemies in }. They are members of the Kapiba family, and can be found at level 35-40 at the Litharia Snowfield on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. Two of them must be defeated to unlock Corvin's level 4 Alae Custodiae Battle Skill.

For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Wolf Shoes and Spring Shoes accessories.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Assault Stones (Japanese: , Asaruto Sutōn) are accessories in and . They increase the damage dealt by Auto-Attacks by up to 50%. They are the upgraded version of the Attack Stone accessory. The Break Stone and Violent Stone accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Attack Stones (Japanese: , Atakku Sutōn) are accessories in and . They increase the damage dealt by Auto-Attacks by up to 30%. The Assault Stone, Break Stone and Violent Stone accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Auto-Balancers (Japanese: , Ōto Baransā) are accessories in and . They prevent the wearer from staggering in response to their attacks getting blocked by the enemy. Ether based attacks cannot be deflected by default, so this accessory will only affect physical Auto-Attacks, Arts and Specials.

Armor Scorpoxes (Japanese: , Āmā Sukopio) are enemies in . They are members of the Scorpox family, and can be found at level 28-30 at the Turbine Tower on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Vale's level 3 "Violence Machine" on her affinity chart.
Armored Fist (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Knuckle Claws. It inflicts Break.

The Artificial Blade Report is a Key Item in . It can be found in a Treasure Trove on a walkway outside the 4th Floor of the Work Observation Tower in the Old Factory in Mor Ardain. It unlocks new parts in Poppiswap.

Aubrite Chips are Core Chips in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They can be dropped by enemies primarily in the Land of Morytha alongside several Unique Monsters. They can also be acquired in the DLC update from two DLC quests and Challenge Battle Mode rewards. Aubrite Chips share their appearance with Angrite Chips, Howardite Chips, and Nakhlite Chips. __TOC__
Ashmi is an NPC in . Ashmi is an Ardainian who can be found in Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Artificial Blade Parts 1 (Japanese: , Biyonkonekuta no Nyūshu, Obtaining Bion Connectors) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received at Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province, after completing The Race to Find Nia.

Artificial Blade Parts 2 (Japanese: , Kanpeki Sokkyo Sensa no Nyūshu, Obtaining a Perfect Range Sensor) is a Main Story Quest in . It is received in Torigoth Market in the Gormott Province, after completing The Race to Find Nia.

The Arrogant Behemoth (Japanese: , Arogento Behimosu) is a quest-exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Behemoth family, and can be found at level 55 near Triedge Isle, on the coast of Temperantia during Lost Kingdom.

Arrodh (Japanese: , Arōda) is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian soldier who can initially be found at the Salvage Point south of the Cargo Transportation Zone in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is later found to be a key member of the Brionac organization. Arrodh offers no quests or merc missions.

The Armu Milk Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Wagon Guard. It enables the purchase of Armu Milk Earl Grey from the Cafe Lutino shop at Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

The Astrology Contract is a Key Item in . It is received as a reward after completing the Merc Mission Crafty Developments. It enables the purchase of Astrology Made Simple from the Biblio Paulio shop in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal.

Armor Breaker (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This arte recycles Mòrag's Armored Fist.

Artificial Intelligence (Japanese: , Tsukurareta Seimei, Manufactured Life) is a Blade Quest in . It can be received from KOS-MOS at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree. It is the only quest available at the World Tree.
Astelle is a character in who appears during KOS-MOS's Blade Quest Artificial Intelligence. She is a Tantalese and Zeke's first cousin once removed.

Arran is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian boy who can be found on the Ayvill Shopping Dist., Roof in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He is spoken to during the quest Failure and Success. Arran offers no quests or merc missions.

Armalia is an NPC in . She is an Indoline who can be found inside the Sanctum in the Indoline Praetorium. She is in charge of the sanctum's chambers and the party must talk to her in order to rest within the sanctum.
Arrow Tirkin are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family that are fought at level 67 during the Merc Assault Mission Big Ship Escort.

Aurelia is an NPC in . She is an Urayan who can be found at Royal Guard Barracks in the Kingdom of Uraya during the DLC Quest A Mercenary's Honor. Aurelia's father, Bonard, was a mercenary comrade of Geoffili's, and died on duty. Len is Aurelia's fiance, having proposed during Beneath the Aurora.

Arrah Rhogul (Japanese: , Āra Rōguru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Rhogul family, and can be found at level 14-18 on Ordia Great Plains, ‎Lyanne Meadow, and Tirkin Cliff Colony near Scowling Quincy in Gormott. One must be defeated to unlock Jin's level 2 Zero Blade Blade Special.

Arpat Rapchors (Japanese: , Arubāto Raputa) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Rapchor family, and can be found at level 96 during Dino Drama, a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This enemy drops no items.

Attack of the Aspar is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Fiora's level 5 Lacerate Blade Special. This challenge takes place near Idora Cave at the Cliffs of Morytha. In this fight, a Yackle Aspar spawn as a level 60 monster. Upon fighting it until it is around half health, it will perform a Skin Upgrade, refilling its health and increasing its level by 10. It will stop doing this at level 200. The Aspar must be defeated in order to succeed.
Ashala is an Ardainian in . She can be found in the Ayvill Shopping District in Alba Cavanich of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Artisanal Accessories is a DLC Quest in . It is part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass. It can be received from Barhanen at the Soprac Old Market in the Kingdom of Tantal after Chapter 7. After completion of this quest, Barhanen operates the So-Called Best Artisan shop at which he can be asked to make Accessories from various Collectibles.

Arrin is an NPC in . She is a Leftherian who can be found first found on the Isle of Urchon in the Leftherian Archipelago during the DLC quest Bright Spark upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass. She can be then found at the Fonsett Residential Area.
Astonishing Slash (Japanese: , Kyōgaku kattā) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when wielding Dual Swords.

Aura Garluses (Japanese: , Ōra Garuusu) are quest-exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They are members of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 62 at the Memorial Ruins in the Kingdom of Tantal during the DLC Blade Quest Corvin's Approach. This enemy drops no items.

The Aurora Garlus (Japanese: , Don'ōra Garuusu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. It is a member of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 68 at the Genbu Crown in the Kingdom of Tantal during the DLC Blade Quest Corvin's Approach. This enemy drops no items.

Arlo Kapibas (Japanese: , Aro Kapība) are enemies in . They are members of the Kapiba family and can be found at level 3 at Porton Village, Hangnail Crossing and the Secluded Boneway and level 8 in Feltley Village in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Four must be defeated to unlock Jin's level 1 "Mind's Eye".

Aristocratic Security is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya after completing the mission Green-Thumbed Mercs. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude" and "Focus" Field Skills. It uniquely awards more Gold than other normal Merc Missions. Completing this mission for the first time unlocks the DLC Merc Mission Wedding Invitation.

Aurea Arduns (Japanese: , Aurea Arudon) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Ardun family and can be found at level 20 - 26 on Wrackham Moor and Olnard's Trail in the Aletta Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two must be defeated to unlock Aegaeon's level 2 Roiling Tide.

Aureus Palace (Japanese: , Ōkyū Aureusu) is a landmark in . It is located in the northernmost area of Auresco, beyond the Sachsum Gardens. The Tornan King resides in and governs from the palace. It can never be entered during gameplay, and its interior is only seen during cutscenes.

The Auresco Residential Ward (Japanese: , Aururiumu Kyojūku, Aurulium Residential Ward) is a location in . It is located in the northwestern area of Auresco, and is largely comprised of residential structures for its citizens. A pathway around a building here leads to Acheron Backstreet.
Aureole (Japanese: , Oriōru) is one of Mythra's Rear Guard Arts in .
Armus Gone Astray is a quest in . It can be received from Teeco at the Spefan Inn in Auresco, the capital of the Kingdom of Torna.
Ascension Waffles are Dessert items in . They can be created by Mythra at Campsites.

Aspar Snakemeats are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be dropped by Aspar enemies found commonly near the Dannagh Desert in the Kingdom of Torna, or by Noble Aspars on Ordia Great Plains and Lyanne Meadow in Gormott.
Armu Carcasses are Key Items in . They are carcasses obtained by defeating Urbs Armus during What Matters Most.

Astle Ellook (Japanese: , Sutera Erūku) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Ellook family and can be found at level 40-42 in the Loftin Nature Preserve in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. They only appear at night, replacing the Marna Garaffa that usually inhabit the region. This enemy has an enhancement which boosts break resistance by 30%.

Astor Flier (Japanese: , Asutoru Furaia) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Flier family, and can be found at level 29 - 41 at Hoary Weald Camp, Coolley Lake, Duelists' Bridge, Valafum Hill, Saints' Practice Grounds, Hoary Weald, and Nebley Wind Cave in Gormott. Three must be defeated to unlock Aegaeon's level 4 Roiling Tide.

Augustus is an NPC in . He is an Urayan soldier who can be found at the Aletta: Militia Garrison in the Kingdom of Torna. His Community can be gained if he is spoken to after Further Feeding Issues, as can Clarke's.
Astronomer's Pot is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Addam at Campsites.
Armored Rucksack is a Key Item in . It can be crafted by Hugo at Campsites.
Ascension Blade (Japanese: ) is Zenobia's Level III Blade Special in .
